name: cg_wideScreen
purpose: Use resolution-aware, proportional HUD coordinates. Disabling this restores the retained legacy aspect path for ordinary HUD elements.

name: cg_hudScale
purpose: Scale the general HUD around each widget's screen anchor. Compass, fireteam panel and expanded command map have separate controls.

name: cg_hudMaxHeight
purpose: Cap the nominal physical height used by the general HUD before its scale is applied.
values: Positive pixel height; 0 removes this cap

name: ui_menuScale
purpose: Scale ordinary menus. The startup main menu, full-frame backgrounds, loading screens and compact voice menu deliberately use separate fixed/fitted scopes.

name: ui_menuMaxHeight
purpose: Cap the nominal height of ordinary menus before ui_menuScale.
values: Positive pixel height; 0 removes this cap

name: cg_compassScale
purpose: Resize the top-right compass independently of general HUD/menu size.

name: cg_fireteamScale
purpose: Resize the top-left fireteam panel independently of general HUD/menu size.

name: cg_commandMapScale
purpose: Resize the expanded command map independently of the HUD and compass. Its border and content share a right-anchored, uniform projection.

name: cg_drawTeamNames
purpose: Show teammate names above their heads. Teammates are white, own-fireteam names light green; only the last visible position briefly fades after occlusion.

name: cg_drawCrosshairNames
purpose: Show the name of the player under the crosshair; this is separate from overhead team labels.

name: cg_drawFriend
purpose: Legacy teammate identification icons and nearby teammate indicators. This is separate from cg_drawTeamNames.
values: 0 off; 1 visible; 2 always, subject to the retained rendering rules

name: cg_drawIcons
purpose: Enable icon/model details in the TCE fireteam presentation.

name: cg_drawFireteamOverlay
purpose: Show the fireteam HUD when the local player belongs to a fireteam. Existing SDK setting with a TCE-specific renderer.

name: cg_drawCompass
purpose: Choose the compass presentation. The TCE map/blueprint options require corresponding map artwork; the renderer retains a safe fallback if art is missing.

name: cg_countryflags
purpose: Show available country flags beside scoreboard player names. Requires server country data.

name: ui_themePreset
purpose: Choose the optional modern menu palette. Existing palette IDs are preserved; RGB controls are used only for Custom.
values: 0 Gold; 1 Cyan; 2 Red; 3 Green; 4 Custom; 5 Black/Grey; 6 Grey/Black; 7 Slate; 8 Copper; 9 Violet

name: ui_themeOpacityPreset
purpose: Select surface opacity. This affects menu surfaces, not text opacity or gameplay rendering.

name: ui_themeOpacity
purpose: Custom surface opacity, used only when ui_themeOpacityPreset is 3.

name: ui_themeAccentR
purpose: Custom accent red channel; used when ui_themePreset is 4.

name: ui_themeAccentG
purpose: Custom accent green channel; used when ui_themePreset is 4.

name: ui_themeAccentB
purpose: Custom accent blue channel; used when ui_themePreset is 4.

name: ui_themeBackgroundR
purpose: Custom menu-surface red channel; used when ui_themePreset is 4.

name: ui_themeBackgroundG
purpose: Custom menu-surface green channel; used when ui_themePreset is 4.

name: ui_themeBackgroundB
purpose: Custom menu-surface blue channel; used when ui_themePreset is 4.

name: ui_backgroundMode
purpose: Choose seasonal, optional weather-driven, or time-of-day-only background selection. The selection is made once per game process and kept through UI/map reloads.
values: 0 Season; 1 Live weather; 2 Time of day only

name: ui_backgroundCountry
purpose: Country code used for seasonal artwork rules. It is not an IP-derived location or an observed snow report.
values: Two-letter uppercase country code; default DE

name: ui_backgroundWinterMonths
purpose: Override the seasonal winter-artwork months. Automatic defaults use northern or southern winter rules; unknown/tropical countries do not infer snow.
values: auto; none; or comma-separated months 1–12, such as 12,1,2

name: ui_backgroundLast
purpose: Archived previous background selection, used to avoid immediately repeating the same appropriate picture.
values: Internal selection ID; normally leave unchanged

name: ui_backgroundSession
purpose: Current process background selection. This is transient UI state rather than a permanent picture selector.

name: g_gametype
purpose: Server game mode. Select it before startup/map load; changing it inside a running TCE game does not perform a supported mode transition. CGame's registration is only a mirror.

name: sv_official
purpose: Retained TC:E official-map policy. Custom-map and custom-mode setups commonly start with this disabled.
values: 0 permits custom setups; 1 applies the official-map policy

name: sv_gametype
purpose: Read-only TC:E game-type state, separate from the operator-facing g_gametype selection.

name: g_mapScriptDirectory
purpose: Directory checked for custom mapscript overrides before the packaged map script. An empty registered default does not mean that local launch configurations cannot select mapscripts.
values: Empty or an override directory such as mapscripts

name: g_newbbox
purpose: Select the retained TC:E player-body/hull profile; the presentation/hit-registration code also uses this profile's scale.
values: 0 legacy smaller profile; 1 enlarged profile; set consistently before playing

name: g_realism
purpose: Retained TC:E realism/movement profile. In particular, 1 selects the normal 0.45 run-speed scale; the alternate branch uses 0.51.

name: g_leanmode
purpose: Retained TC:E lean presentation and shot-position policy, published to clients.
values: 0 versus positive values select the retained lean policies

name: g_killmessage
purpose: Retained kill-message policy published to clients; distinct from the new HUD scaling settings.

name: g_starthonor
purpose: Initial honor/armament-progression setting used by the retained TC:E round rules.

name: g_aabasetime
purpose: Read-only armament-availability progression interval. Mapscript actions set it; non-GT5 modes use the interval in minutes.

name: g_botvar
purpose: Multiplier used by the retained TC:E bot-info enemy-selection probability code. It is not an Omni-bot crowd-distance or skill control.

name: g_antilag
purpose: Existing SDK antialag setting extended with optional TCE hit-debug layers. Bit 1 enables rewind; bits 2 and 4 request the corresponding rewound/current diagnostic shot layers.
values: Bitmask: 1 rewind; 2 rewound-shot diagnostics; 4 current-shot diagnostics

name: g_debugBullets
purpose: Existing cheat-protected bullet diagnostic selector. TCE additions use bit 2 for box/trace drawing, 4 for periodic samples, and 8 for bounded diagnostic logging.
values: 0 off; combine supported diagnostic bits; sv_cheats is required

name: g_debugBulletsClient
purpose: Limit TCE hit diagnostics to a client slot.
values: -1 all; otherwise a valid client number

name: g_countryflags
purpose: Enable server country lookup and choose bot nationality handling. Uses an optional local IPv4 GeoIP.dat; missing data falls back to unknown/local identifiers.
values: 0 off; 1 real players plus configured server address for bots; 2 random bot country icons

name: g_oss
purpose: Advertise available client-platform binaries to compatible browsers. This does not install modules, enforce architecture access or detect deployed files.
values: Bitmask; 2047 advertises all eleven represented platform flags

name: lua_modules
purpose: Space/semicolon-separated server Lua module paths loaded by the optional FEATURE_LUA runtime. Use lua_restart in the server console/RCON after changing the list.
values: Empty disables module loading; example lua/wolfadmin/main.lua

name: wolfadmin_password
purpose: Optional WolfAdmin session-login password. Empty disables password login; keep a configured value in a server-private configuration.
values: Empty or a private operator-selected password; not serverinfo/userinfo

name: g_wolfadminTrustGuid
purpose: Explicitly allow WolfAdmin to trust a unique valid client-supplied GUID. TCE's GUIDs are not engine-authenticated; console administration does not need this opt-in.
values: 0 default distrust; 1 explicit GUID trust opt-in

name: cl_guid
purpose: Existing engine/client identity variable. The UI preserves a valid existing GUID, otherwise derives one from an existing etmain/etkey for classic ET; it does not create or replace the key.
values: 32 hexadecimal characters supplied/derived at runtime; not a fixed default

name: omnibot_enable
purpose: Load the optional Omni-bot gameplay runtime on map initialization. The matching core library and scripts must be installed.

name: omnibot_path
purpose: Optional Omni-bot core-library search path. Empty uses the loader's platform-specific search locations.
values: Empty or a configured core-library directory; latched

name: omnibot_flags
purpose: Retained Omni-bot option bitmask. Its declared bits cover XP-save, tank/gun mounting, advertised bot count, gib targeting, mine handling and shove integration; only applicable TCE interactions have an effect.

name: omnibot_playing
purpose: Read-only bot-count/status information maintained by the integration.
values: 0 initially; positive active count; -1 when disabled in the update path

name: omnibot_tce_explore
purpose: Allow the TCE exploration goal when normal objective/combat conditions permit. It still uses installed navigation and cannot invent missing paths.

name: bot_editWaypoints
purpose: Original navigation-editing state retained only in FEATURE_NAVSTUDIO authoring builds.
values: Transient editor state; not a public Game control

name: cg_omnibotdrawing
purpose: Master Omni-bot waypoint/goal drawing switch in the authoring CGame.
values: 0 off; 1 on; requires the Editor variant

name: cg_omnibot_render_distance
purpose: Maximum distance for authoring navigation/goal drawing, limiting submitted debug geometry.
values: Game units; default 800; requires the Editor variant

name: omnibot_tce_explore_debug
purpose: Native registration for exploration diagnostics is restricted to FEATURE_NAVSTUDIO. Some installed GM scripts also read this name.
values: 0 silent; nonzero script diagnostics; no public authoring interface

name: tce_version
purpose: Read-only TCE2 mod version string compiled from TCE_VERSION.
values: 1.0.4 in the current source; version marker, not a tuning setting

name: tce_pose
purpose: CGame userinfo capability/acknowledgement for the shared pose-presentation protocol. The server issues and validates the runtime challenge.
values: 0 initially; protocol-generated acknowledgement; do not set manually

name: tce_poseChallengeCounter
purpose: Server-maintained counter used to issue pose-protocol challenges.

name: tce_poseProtocol
purpose: Server pose-presentation protocol identifier.

name: tce_poseStep
purpose: Server-published pose update step. The initial 50 ms registration is replaced with the observed valid frame step.
values: Read-only milliseconds; 50 is the initialization fallback

name: tce_scannerRecipientPackets
purpose: Enable the TCE scanner/compass recipient-packet extension.

name: tceft
purpose: Client userinfo capability for TCE fireteam information.

name: tceftgear
purpose: Client userinfo capability for the richer fireteam equipment payload.

name: cg_aspectMode
purpose: Legacy aspect-canvas selector. Automatic widescreen handling bypasses this selector for ordinary HUD geometry.

name: cg_aspectFovMode
purpose: Legacy field-of-view adaptation policy for the selected TC:E aspect mode.

name: cg_dynamicEye
purpose: Strength of the retained screen-brightness/eye-adaptation effect; this does not add an HDR renderer to the engine.

name: cg_freeAim
purpose: Enable the TC:E free-aim input policy; the preference is sent in userinfo.

name: cg_gunPosition
purpose: Horizontal first-person weapon placement.
values: 0 more centered; 1 default; 2 more to the right

name: cg_portalScopes
purpose: Enable the retained second-scene/portal scope presentation where the selected weapon supports it.

name: cg_predictBullets
purpose: Enable the retained client bullet-effect prediction path. Server damage remains authoritative.

name: cg_toggleAiming
purpose: Choose toggle-style aiming instead of holding the aiming action.

name: cg_toggleCrouch
purpose: Choose toggle-style crouching instead of holding crouch.

name: cg_gunPitch
purpose: Developer first-person weapon pitch offset.

name: cg_gunYaw
purpose: Developer first-person weapon yaw offset.

name: cg_gunRoll
purpose: Developer first-person weapon roll offset.

name: cg_tacX
purpose: Developer tactical first-person weapon X offset.

name: cg_tacY
purpose: Developer tactical first-person weapon Y offset.

name: cg_tacZ
purpose: Developer tactical first-person weapon Z offset.

name: cg_gun_foreshorten
purpose: Override positive weapon-model foreshortening in the retained view-weapon renderer.
values: 0 normal behavior; positive developer override; cheat-protected

name: cg_thirdPersonOffset
purpose: Side offset of the retained third-person camera.

name: cg_snd_reverb
purpose: Scale the retained room/sound-zone contribution. It is not an engine-wide new audio backend.

name: cg_hudAlpha
purpose: Legacy TC:E archived binding. No current production reader of this variable was identified; modern menu transparency uses ui_themeOpacityPreset/ui_themeOpacity instead.
values: Registered value retained for compatibility; do not use as the modern transparency control

name: cg_specSwing
purpose: Legacy archived binding; toggleswing still updates it, but no current presentation consumer was identified.
values: Compatibility state; not a verified modern camera feature

name: cg_vip
purpose: Legacy archived binding with no identified current production consumer.

name: cg_recording_showstatusline
purpose: Legacy transient recording-status binding with no identified current production consumer.

name: cg_draw2D
purpose: Existing HUD drawing switch, made cheat-protected in the TC:E source snapshot.
values: HUD suppression is additionally restricted by the existing developer check

name: cg_drawCrosshair
purpose: Existing crosshair selector. CGame's TC:E default/cheat flags differ from the UI's inherited archived binding; the registrations share one engine cvar.
values: Do not infer an effective runtime default from UI's registration alone

name: cg_drawGun
purpose: Existing first-person gun drawing switch. CGame's TC:E binding is cheat-protected; the UI has an archived mirror.
values: 0 hidden; nonzero drawn, subject to gameplay policy

name: cg_fov
purpose: Existing field-of-view setting with TC:E cheat-protected registration. Scope/aspect policies still affect the actual view.
values: Legacy field-of-view preference; not an unrestricted public FOV override

name: cg_shadows
purpose: Existing player-shadow presentation selector, cheat-protected by the TC:E binding.

name: g_autoFireteams
purpose: Existing automatic fireteam policy; TC:E registers it archived.

name: g_friendlyFire
purpose: Existing friendly-fire policy. QGame uses SERVERINFO + CHEAT; UI adds an archived mirror of the same name.
values: 0 off; 1 on, subject to protection/game-mode rules

name: g_gravity
purpose: Existing world-gravity setting, cheat-protected in this TC:E registration.

name: g_speed
purpose: Existing base movement-speed parameter, cheat-protected in TC:E. Actual TCE movement also applies posture and realism scales.
values: Default 320; not a direct promise of running speed

name: g_lms_matchlimit
purpose: Existing SDK LMS match-limit binding. QGame and UI retain different registration defaults; TCE's documented public modes are 2, 5 and 7.

name: g_lms_roundlimit
purpose: Existing SDK LMS round-limit binding. QGame and UI retain different registration defaults.

name: g_warmup
purpose: Existing warmup duration. QGame registers 25, UI's inherited mirror registers 60; server/map configuration and registration order matter.
values: Seconds; do not treat a UI mirror as the server's configured value

name: match_minplayers
purpose: Existing minimum-player match setting. QGame and UI bindings have different persistence flags.

name: ui_gametype
purpose: UI game-type selection state adapted to the TC:E default mode.
values: UI state, not a substitute for startup g_gametype

name: ui_netGametype
purpose: UI network game-type selection state adapted to TC:E.

name: ui_menuFiles
purpose: UI menu registry path; TC:E selects the appropriate game-type registry.

name: r_fastsky
purpose: Engine renderer cvar also registered by the legacy TC:E CGame with a cheat flag. This is not a newly implemented TCE2 renderer setting.
values: Use the host engine's documented behavior

name: mapname
purpose: Read-only current map information mirrored by several mod subsystems. Repeated binding changes in history are not additions of new maps or game modes.
